# Appliance cycle (`appliance-cycle`)

A washing machine or dishwasher programme: stage, time left, progress, and a finished state.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createApplianceCycle` (types in `dist/web/home/rooms/applianceCycle.d.ts`): `.mh-appliance-cycle` (on a `.mh-control-card` frame): the state and programme on the state line, an optional pause or resume button in the trailing slot, then `__time` (time left large, `__ends` beside it), a progress bar, `__stages` (an ordered list; the running stage has `aria-current="step"`) and, when finished, a success `__done` line with a dismiss button. Modifier `--<state>`.

```ts
export function createApplianceCycle(options: ApplianceCycleOptions): ApplianceCycleHandle;

export interface ApplianceCycleOptions {
  /** The appliance's name ("Washing machine"); also the card's accessible name. */
  name: string;
  /** Default a washing machine. */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  state: ApplianceState;
  /** The programme ("Cotton 40°"). */
  programme?: string;
  /** The programme's stages in order ("Wash", "Rinse", "Spin"). */
  stages?: readonly string[];
  /** Index of the stage running now. */
  stage?: number | null;
  /** Seconds left. */
  remaining?: number | null;
  /** Percent done, 0 to 100 (default from `remaining` and `duration` when both are known). */
  progress?: number | null;
  /** Total seconds of the programme. */
  duration?: number | null;
  /** When it ends or ended, as the app formats it ("Ends 14:20", "Done at 14:20"). */
  endsAt?: string;
  /** What is wrong while `state` is `error` ("Door open"). */
  error?: string;
  labels?: Partial<ApplianceCycleLabels>;
  unavailable?: boolean;
  /** Shows a pause button while running (and resume while paused). */
  onPause?: () => void;
  onResume?: () => void;
  /** Shows a button on the finished state (the load has been taken out). */
  onDismiss?: () => void;
}

export interface ApplianceCycleHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(changes: Partial<ApplianceCycleOptions>): void;
}

/** Every visible or spoken word, for translation. */
export interface ApplianceCycleLabels {
  states: Record<ApplianceState, string>;
  /** "1 h 12 min left". */
  left(time: string): string;
  progress: string;
  stages: string;
  pause: string;
  resume: string;
  /** The finished state's button ("Done": the laundry is out). */
  dismiss: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createApplianceCycle, type ApplianceState } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const duration = 5400;
let remaining = 4320;
let state: ApplianceState = 'running';

const set = (next: ApplianceState): void => {
  state = next;
  cycle.update({ state });
};

const cycle = createApplianceCycle({
  name: 'Washing machine',
  state,
  programme: 'Cotton 40°',
  stages: ['Wash', 'Rinse', 'Spin'],
  stage: 0,
  remaining,
  duration,
  endsAt: 'Ends 14:20',
  onPause: () => set('paused'),
  onResume: () => set('running'),
  onDismiss: () => cycle.el.remove(),
});

setInterval(() => {
  if (state !== 'running') return;
  remaining = Math.max(0, remaining - 60);
  if (remaining === 0) set('finished');
  else cycle.update({ remaining, stage: Math.floor(((duration - remaining) / duration) * 3) });
}, 60_000);

document.body.append(cycle.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { ApplianceCycle } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { ApplianceState } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const duration = 5400;

export function ApplianceCycleExample() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ApplianceState>('running');
  const [remaining, setRemaining] = useState(4320);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (state !== 'running') return;
    const tick = setInterval(() => setRemaining((left) => Math.max(0, left - 60)), 60_000);
    return () => clearInterval(tick);
  }, [state]);

  if (!shown) return null;
  return (
    <ApplianceCycle
      name="Washing machine"
      state={remaining === 0 ? 'finished' : state}
      programme="Cotton 40°"
      stages={['Wash', 'Rinse', 'Spin']}
      stage={Math.floor(((duration - remaining) / duration) * 3)}
      remaining={remaining}
      duration={duration}
      endsAt="Ends 14:20"
      onPause={() => setState('paused')}
      onResume={() => setState('running')}
      onDismiss={() => setShown(false)}
    />
  );
}
```
